experiment: Synthetic Slab dataset (2-D features, binary label), fully connected network; source domains with linear-feature noise p=0.0 and 0.1, target domain p=1.0; methods ERM, DANN, MMD, CORAL, RandMatch, CDANN, C-MMD, C-CORAL, PerfMatch
notes: Table 7 gives per-method regularization hyperparameters. Optimal lambda: DANN 0.01 (gradient penalty 0.1, discriminator steps 4); CDANN 0.01 (gradient penalty 1.0, discriminator steps 2); MMD 0.1; C-MMD 0.1; CORAL 0.1; C-CORAL 0.1; RandMatch 1.0; PerfMatch 1.0.
Epochs: 100 total with early stopping on validation loss (Suppl. A.1). Suppl. C.3 says generically that early stopping uses source validation accuracy; Slab-specific text says validation loss.
Main text says numbers are averaged over 3 runs, but the Table 1 caption says 10 seeds; 10 used here.
Slab parameters: k=7 slabs, margin m=0.1, slab label flip probability ps=0.1. Validation: 250 extra points per source domain.
Table 8 hyperparameters are for other datasets, not the slab dataset.
Momentum, Nesterov, LR schedule, resize, normalization and augmentation are not stated for the slab experiment.
